Welcome to ULaMDyn's documentation!
===================================

**ULaMDyn** is a python-based toolkit for data analysis of (nonadiabatic) molecular dynamics (MD) simulations build on top of the  Pandas and Scikit-Learn framework. 
It provides a set of methods to perform the preprocessing, statistical, and unsupervised learning analysis of MD trajectories data generated by the Newton-X program. 
ULaMDyn was designed to automate the search/discovery of hidden patterns in high-dimensional molecular data sets, thereby enhancing the interpretability and 
understanding of nonadiabatic dynamics simulations.

Features
--------

- Statistical analysis:

  - Perform a descriptive statistics by computing the median, mean and standard deviation over all available MD trajectories.
  - The bootstrap algorithm can be used to determine the uncertainty of molecular properties within a given confidence level.

- For dimensionality reduction:

  - Principal Component Analysis (PCA).
  - Kernel Principal Component Analysis (KPCA).
  - Isometric Mapping.
  - t-distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding (TSNE).

- To identify clusters:

  - K-Means clustering.
  - Hierarchical agglomerative clustering.
  - Spectral clustering.
